# 07 Live Talking Points

## Goal

A user sees draft talking points during a live meeting, then receives final talking points from the final rebuild after recording stops.

## Why This Comes Now

After the recording, finalization, durability, and user notes surfaces are stable, the system can safely add generated live insight previews without confusing them with final rebuilt artifacts.

## Included Scope

- Generate draft talking points from the live transcript while recording continues.
- Label live talking points as draft or provisional.
- Update draft talking points as more transcript context arrives.
- On finalization, replace draft talking points with final talking points from the rebuild path.
- Preserve private notes separately from generated talking points.

## Not Included

- User task extraction or reconciliation.
- Speaker labelling, audio playback, or review-time transcript sync.
- Manual editing or pinning of talking points.
- Treating live draft talking points as final meeting output.

## Acceptance

These criteria map to `tests/bets/meeting-recording/test_milestone_07_live_talking_points.py`. Run via `./dev test bet meeting-recording`.

- [ ] Draft talking points appear while a live transcript is streaming.
- [ ] Draft talking points are visibly marked as provisional.
- [ ] Draft talking points update as additional transcript context arrives.
- [ ] Stopping the recording triggers final rebuild through the shared finalization path.
- [ ] Final talking points replace draft talking points after rebuild completes.
- [ ] Private notes remain unchanged when talking points are generated or replaced.
